title: Largest band, touring and playing with Desdunes
summary: Papa Celestin's twelve-piece band, road trips, a stint with Desdunes, and Harmony Inn band names.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: I can read music. What's the largest band you ever played with other than the WPA? Well, by both bands, folk. Papi Solastain. How big a band would he have?

Twelve pieces. Twelve pieces and an entertainer. And where would he work with Twelve Pieces? Oh, out of town mostly. That time I was playing music, I'd be hitting the roads, you know what I mean. And he was a man that would get Boyk. He was one of the ones, he was actually one of the ones. He would get Boyk all over. Go to a lot of town sometimes for his, Pensacola.
A lot of time. Uh huh. It must have been interesting to travel around throughout the country, Todd.

Yeah. Sightseeing. Yeah. And especially we had our own bus too, you know what I mean. I was just saying, I was understanding. Oh and one time I played with Desdun. Crash Desdun. Oh yeah, Crash Desdun huh? Yeah. I don't even know who it is.
You travel over here? Oh yeah. I'm on New Brunswick. No. That's where he is now, isn't it?
No, he's dead now. He's dead now. But he's from Omaha.

Oh yeah. I know he'd come down here sometime. Yeah. I don't want to see his name in advertisements, you know. Yeah. In the old newspapers all I can know. Old time people, yeah. I forget, did he play on the boat or not? No, no. Not on the boat, he was in the dances and stuff. No, he was playing on the boat. He used to play violin and led the band. So he did. Who would he have in his man? George McCullough, of course, and myself.
Raymond Brown. What did he play? Which one? Trombone. Trombone. He's dead now. Yeah.

There's two Raymond Browns, isn't it? His son's name was Raymond too, I think. Yeah. Trombone. Yeah, they called him Clifford or something, didn't they? Clifford Brown. I think his real name was Raymond, somebody told me. I can't remember who told me. I think Andy Anderson. Yeah, he's out of time, isn't he? Clifford? Clifford Brown. I think his real name was Raymond, somebody told me. They just called him Clifford to make the difference for father and son. I can't remember who told me. I think Andy Anderson. Yeah, he's out of time, isn't he? Clifford? Let's see. That's not the Clifford Brown that was killed, the youngster. No, no. Let's see. Did we have a question? Did we have a question? I don't know. Let's see. Did we get those guys first names? Let's see. You said Degard on drums, but it wasn't. It's Alex Degard and Andy Anderson on trumpet. And Smitty's on piano. And myself. And yourself. And Louis Gallo has just left. That's right. He was there Saturday night, but Friday night Smitty starts. Yeah. So, uh. How do you feel about playing for the people down there? How. What do you do when the people come up and ask you for a number?
